active_ingredient: DRUG FACTS Active Ingredients : Salicylic Acid 2%
indications_and_usage: Uses • For the treatment of acne
warnings: Warnings: • For external use only. When using this product skin irritation and dryness is more likely to occur if you use another topical acne medication at the same time. If irritation occurs, only use one topical acne medication at a time.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: • Keep out of the reach of children. If swallowed get medical help or contact a Poison Control center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions: • Lather in hands with water and wash face for 30 seconds • Rinse clean • Keep out of eyes
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients: Water, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, PEG-150 Distearate, Isopentyldiol, Coco-Glucoside, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Benzoate
